findings.evidence: `Cyclic.lean:43` supplies `[Finite G]` to declarations at lines 48, 54, and 60; Mathlib provides infinite cyclic equivalences at `Mathlib/GroupTheory/SpecificGroups/Cyclic.lean:557`, while only the chosen helper `IsCyclic.index_powMonoidHom_range` at line 634 requires `[Finite G]`.
findings.fix: Remove `[Finite G]` from the public signatures and prove the cardinality theorem by splitting into finite and infinite cases, using the equivalence of an infinite cyclic group with `Multiplicative ℤ` for the latter.
findings.issue: The file-level `[Finite G]` unnecessarily restricts all three cyclic results; for infinite cyclic `G`, `Nat.card G = 0`, so the cardinality formula and its even-card and two-rank consequences still hold.

summary: The cyclic square-class API remains unnecessarily restricted to finite cyclic groups, excluding the natural infinite cyclic case.
